subject: Naxxramas bosses: Classic Era encounter sources for every class

retrieval.method: Fetched once per page through the implementing agent's fetch tool (wiki.gg blocks plain HTTP clients), asking for verbatim sentences only. The tool caps each quote at 125 characters: longer sentences come back cut, sometimes marked with '...', and on some pages (Heigan, Anub'Rekhan, Gothik) the longest sentences were left out instead. Kel'Thuzad came back as a selection, not every qualifying sentence. Season of Discovery, Season of Mastery, Wrath of the Lich King, level 70 and loot lines were excluded.
retrieval.boundary: Excerpts are guide text, not observations. Strategy sentences describe one guild approach among several; a rule built on them must say so and must not grade a player against an assignment the log cannot show. Fragments are quoted as returned and cannot carry a claim about the part that was cut.

followup.method: Targeted expanded search results supplied cached Classic page text despite direct wiki.gg HTTP 403. The same fetch can select different sections; omitted context remains unresolved. No SoD, Wrath or level-70 advice used.

excerpts.warrior_hit_reference: The average hit is ~8000 damage on a fully buffed BWL/AQ40 geared Warrior in defensive stance.

excerpts.hp_and_enrage_timer: Patchwerk has about 3,850,000 HP and a 7 minute enrage time limit (your raid needs ~9500 dps minimum to kill him in time).

excerpts.druid_tanks: Several guilds have successfully utilised feral druids as Hateful Strike tanks as they are able to attain
excerpts.aggro_locked_belief: As noted above, the belief that aggro remains locked to the main tank is questionable, since off tanks
excerpts.offtank_count: The best seems to be 3, it allows you plenty of time to heal up the OTs without spreading out healing too much.
excerpts.last_stand_note: Note: If off tanks use Last Stand or Lifegiving Gem they might kick someone out of rotation,
excerpts.single_ot_allocation: Single OT: The OT is topped up at full HP all the time, so every 1.2 sec when Hateful Strike comes,

excerpts.poison_cloud_effect: Emits a poison cloud 10 yards wide.
excerpts.poison_cloud_damage: The cloud deals high amounts of Nature damage, meaning the MT needs to keep moving while tanking.
excerpts.slime_spray_spawn: Party members who are hit will spawn a Fallout Slime.
excerpts.fallout_slime: A Blob that deals 300dmg/2seconds, in a 10 yard range AoE.
excerpts.mutating_injection: Injects a target with a mutagen that will do a 4500 physical damage AoE after 10 sec, or a lower-damage AoE when cleansed.
excerpts.injection_cloud: The target will create a poison cloud with the same effect as Grobbulus himself,
excerpts.injection_cleanse_risk: so the target will need to run to the side when cleansed to avoid damaging the rest of the raid.
excerpts.slime_stream: Slime Stream is an AoE DoT deals 4500 Nature damage over 3 sec.
excerpts.slime_stream_trigger: This ability is considered to be triggered when the MT gets out of the melee range of Grobbulus
excerpts.tank_positioning: The maintank stands upon the ramp which Grobbulus patrols, slowly moving him to avoid his poison cloud attack.
excerpts.tank_wall_hug: The MT hugs the outside wall all the way around the room.
excerpts.boss_movement: Grobbulus should be moved as slowly as possible for the best use of space, as his cloud will limit the room's safe zone.
excerpts.dps_ranged: DPS on Grobbulus is ranged, so as to avoid spawning multiple fallout slimes.
excerpts.slime_handling: Only one slime should be spawned at a time
excerpts.slime_dispatch: They dispatch this slime, away from the ranged/healers, then return to adding ranged dps.
excerpts.injected_movement: Injected people should run to the edge of existing clouds, as far away from the the raid as possible
excerpts.phase_30_percent: At 30% Grobbulus injects people more frequently
excerpts.cleanse_note: Cleanse will lower the amount of damage you take, but it will start the AoE where they are standing.
excerpts.ramp_hazard: Sometimes the ramp seems safe but there is a poison cloud effect at the base of the ramp.
excerpts.cloud_awareness: Everyone always needs to be aware of the growing green clouds at all times.
excerpts.hunter_shaman_nature_tip: are really useful because Grobbulus has many Nature-damage abilities
excerpts.aspect_stacking: They don´t stack so if you have hunter in your raid, you should use Aspect of the Wild.
excerpts.hunter_shaman_nature_tip_subjects: Hunters Image [Aspect of the Wild] and Shamans Image [Nature Resistance Totem]/Image [Poison Cleansing Totem]

excerpts.mortal_wound: Mortal Wound - Stackable debuff on the MT that reduces healing by 10%.
excerpts.frenzy_dispel: A hunter must use Tranquilizing Shot to dispel it.
excerpts.decimate: Gluth stomps the ground once every ~105 seconds, Decimating all raid members and zombies.
excerpts.decimate_effect: Decimate reduces the health of every raid member and zombie to 5% of their maximum HP
excerpts.terrifying_roar: Gluth does an AoE fear similar to the one used by Nefarian every 20 secs (range is less than 20 yards).
excerpts.devour_zombie_spawn: Multiple zombies will spawn from the side of the chamber during the encounter.
excerpts.devour_zombie_heal: If a zombie gets close enough to him, he can devour it to restore health (5%).
excerpts.tank_position: Tank the boss near the door, with his head towards the door.
excerpts.two_tanks: Two tanks are required in order to prevent the healing debuff from stacking too high, just like in the Fankriss fight.
excerpts.enrage_strategy: He enrages 10–20 seconds after the third Decimate.
excerpts.zombie_spawns: Adds will spawn at the three green grates near the tunnel from which you enter the room.
excerpts.zombie_kite_timer: These need to be kited for 105 seconds until the decimate goes off.
excerpts.decimate_prep: Once Gluth casts decimate, top off the MT (a druid NS rotation works well).
excerpts.zombie_health: This will reduce their health to 5%, allowing them to easily be zerged down.
excerpts.zombie_grouping: Be careful though, 5% is still 6104 hp, so you will need to group them up.
excerpts.zombie_focus: They must be killed before they reach and heal, so all DPS must shift focus from the boss to the zombies.
excerpts.infected_wound: The Zombies have an Infected Wound ability, which increases physical damage by 100 for 1 minute.
excerpts.fear_ward_usage: Fear Wards should be used wisely
excerpts.fear_ward_main_tank: By fear warding the main tank you ensure aggro
excerpts.fear_ward_gluth_movement: if the Main Tank is feared Gluth will follow the Main Tank
excerpts.mage_warrior_kiting: One of the most effective way to deal with the zombies is a combination of mage and warrior kiting
excerpts.mage_fireblast: Mages can fireblast mobs as they spawn to get initial aggro.
excerpts.zombie_vulnerabilities: The zombies are vulnerable to Piercing Howl as well as the slow effect from Cone of Cold, Improved Blizzard and Frost Nova.
excerpts.hunter_frost_traps: Hunter's frost traps work well too.
excerpts.corner_positioning: Mages and warriors need to stay in their corners in order to prevent Gluth from being in range of his zombies
excerpts.wide_scale_kiting: Hunters/paladins/warriors can and should all be used to keep the adds away from the healers and from Gluth.
excerpts.frost_nova_rotation: Frost Nova rotations are very effective, though they should not be depended on completely due to healer aggro.
excerpts.shackle_undead_use: Shackle Undead can also be used on the zombies
excerpts.shackle_undead_restriction: should be used only on stray zombies that may have aggro'd on to healers and such.
excerpts.turn_evil_warning: Using Turn Evil or Turn Undead is extremely unwise
excerpts.turn_evil_feared_zombie: if the zombie is feared and runs toward Gluth, Gluth will eat it and heal himself.

excerpts.feugen_stalagg_health: Feugen and Stalagg each have 499,650 health.
excerpts.magnetic_pull: Pulls an enemy target from the opposite platform to the caster.
excerpts.warstomp: Knocks back all enemies within 15 yards, dealing ~1500 physical damage.
excerpts.tesla_coil: Tesla Coils are linked to their respective wight.
excerpts.shock: Instantly deals 4375 to 5625 Nature damage. Cast every second. Hits ~5 targets per cast.
excerpts.static_field: Burns 500 mana from all enemies within 30 yards every 6 seconds, dealing shadow damage
excerpts.power_surge: Increases the caster's attack speed by 200% for 10 sec.
excerpts.chain_lightning: Strikes an enemy with a lightning bolt for 2000 nature damage that arcs to another nearby enemy.
excerpts.polarity_shift: Polarize all nearby enemies, placing either a Negative Charge or a Positive Charge on each target
excerpts.ball_lightning: Inflicts 7000 to 9000 nature damage to an enemy target.
excerpts.berserk: After 5 minutes of being active, Thaddius goes into a berserker rage
excerpts.strategy_phase_one_roles: Due to their mechanics, casters should fight Stalagg, while melee should fight Feugen.
excerpts.strategy_ranged_outrange: Mages and hunters can outrange Feugen's mana drain
excerpts.strategy_charge_movement: Players whose polarity changes have 5 seconds to run to the location for their new polarity.
excerpts.strategy_two_groups: It is important for the raid to stand in two groups because Thaddius must be killed within 5 minutes
excerpts.strategy_hunter_range: Hunters especially need to make sure they remain within range to maximize the charge debuff stacks.

excerpts.strategy_no_rez: It is therefore never advisable to use a battle rez or soulstone during phase two.
excerpts.healing_tanks: Thaddius doesn't deal very much melee damage to an appropriately geared main tank
excerpts.tanking_damage: Thaddius hits for about 2k normal, 3.3k crushing.

excerpts.curse_of_plaguebringer_desc: Curses the target with the Curse of the Plaguebringer.
excerpts.curse_importance: It is of the utmost importance that all Druids and Mages decurse this immediately, and that only melee DPS are hit by it.
excerpts.curse_failure: If the inflicted are not dispelled of the curse, they will become infected along with all of their nearby allies
excerpts.wrath_desc: Infects nearby allies, inflicting Nature damage, then additional damage every 5 sec. for 10 sec.
excerpts.wrath_damage: Deals 875 to 1125 shadow damage every 2 sec.
excerpts.wrath_warning: This should hopefully never be applied to anyone in the raid
excerpts.blink_desc: He blinks periodically throughout the fight, causing a complete Aggro wipe.
excerpts.blink_cooldown: Cooldown is around 25 seconds when he is in the room, and he only travels a short distance, maybe 20 yards.
excerpts.blink_counters: Several ways to counter, including Intercept, Feral Charge, and having a secondary tank
excerpts.blink_shaman: When Noth teleports to the balcony, all shaman should drop down Frost Resist totem so as to not break any shackles.
excerpts.skeleton_spawns: Every 30 sec Noth summons an army of skeletons.
excerpts.cripple_desc: doing an AoE debuff that slows movement, attack speed, and strength by 50%.
excerpts.cripple_dispel: A priest/paladin should be assigned to remove this from the MT as soon as the Blink occurs.
excerpts.teleport_champions: 90 sec after initial aggro Noth teleports to a balcony making him unreachable for DPS
excerpts.teleport_champions_end: Once these waves are beaten or 70 seconds have passed, he teleports back down.
excerpts.teleport_champions_guardians: 110 sec after the 1st Teleport Noth teleports again to a balcony making him unreachable for DPS
excerpts.plagued_guardians_immune: Plagued Guardians are immune to shackle.
excerpts.teleport_guardians: 180 sec after the 2nd Teleport Noth teleports to a balcony making him unreachable for DPS
excerpts.strategy_tanks: Have tanks at each spawn point.
excerpts.strategy_ranged_assist: Assign mages and other ranged damage dealers to assist the warrior when spawns appear.
excerpts.strategy_decurse: Mages and Druids MUST decurse the raid when he does his AoE curse, or the raid will wipe.
excerpts.strategy_blink_dps: When Noth blinks, stop DPS until he is back onto the MT.
excerpts.strategy_mt_threat: It's recommended for MT to be Full Protection as you need to generate a large ammount of threat
excerpts.strategy_first_balcony: On the first balcony phase he summons 2 waves of plagued champions which must be focus fired
excerpts.strategy_second_balcony: Usually half the raid takes out the one in the northeast and half the raid takes out the one in the southwest.
excerpts.strategy_second_descent: On Noth's 2nd descent, he must be concentrated on by everyone except the off tanks which will tank up to 4 or 5 Plagued Warriors.
excerpts.strategy_after_teleport: After Noth returns after his 2nd teleport, max DPS on Noth, shackle and tank any spawns.
excerpts.strategy_third_phase: You will probably not survive the third mob phase, so you have to get him down before.
excerpts.strategy_adds_tanks: Make sure that you have tanks that can pick adds up.
excerpts.note_pull: NOTE: At the pull the entire raid must be in the room or they will be locked out until Noth resets

excerpts.tunnel_plague_disease: Disease aura, doing damage to raid.

excerpts.tunnel_bat_putrid_bite: Putrid Bite - Increases the damage taken by an enemy by 120 for 30 sec.

excerpts.poison_aura_damage: 196 Nature damage inflicted every 6 seconds for 12 seconds.

excerpts.fungal_bloom_crit: Fungal Bloom — Critical-hit chance increased by 50%.
excerpts.fungal_bloom_threat: Spells and abilities cause no threat.
excerpts.fungal_bloom_control: Get from environment, you can control who gets it.
excerpts.fungal_bloom_timing: 90 secs duration, spawns every 12 secs, every time only 5 people can get it.
excerpts.healer_limit: Healers will only be allowed to cast one healing spell every minute.
excerpts.healer_tank_only: This means healers will only be able to heal the Main Tank while the rest of the raid must use consumables to stay alive.
excerpts.healer_rotation: Healers should set up a rotation to determine when and who heals the tank.
excerpts.aura_nature_damage: Loatheb has an aura that deals Nature damage to players and pets in melee range.
